unit: Institute to End Mass Incarceration (Harvard HLS)

labs.research_summary: Works with people most affected by the penal system to build community power and advance ideas and legal work aimed at ending mass incarceration.
labs.join_notes: The Join Our Team page says there are no current opportunities and invites people to follow the institute on social media and join the mailing list for updates.
labs.notes: Member count left blank: the team page lists the director, a managing director (also Executive Editor of Inquest), an attorney, a policy fellow and a research associate, but also 6 student attorneys for 2026 and about 24 for earlier years, 3 more Inquest editors and 5 fellows, with no clear current core group. Contact email is behind the site's email protection, so not recorded. Address and phone not shown on pages read.
